statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The patient has symptomatic paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has sick sinus syndrome
The patient has underlying nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during daily activities
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to service delivery
